subject: geography

items.q: What is post-glacial rebound an example of?
items.why: The answer examiners want is: Isostatic. “Eustatic” is the distractor this question was built around — if it tempted you, that's the exact gap to close.
Correct answer: 1.8m/year. “0.5m/year” sounds right because it borrows the language of the topic — but it fails this question. Re-read the notes on why.

items.q: How many sediment cells does England have?
items.why: Exact answer: 11 cells. Estimation gets you near it; only the anchored number survives the exam hall.
